facts.fact: StackAdapt platform data shows a native-only campaign may reach 53% of a target audience.
facts.quote: If a campaign is running native only, it may reach 53% of a target audience.

facts.fact: StackAdapt platform data shows that running native together with display yields a total campaign reach of 87% of a target audience.
facts.quote: if native is run along with display, the total campaign reach would be 87%.

facts.fact: StackAdapt platform data shows that running native together with video yields a total campaign reach of 83% of a target audience.
facts.quote: if native is run with video added, the total campaign reach would be 83%.

facts.fact: StackAdapt platform data shows a CTV-only campaign may reach 9% of a target audience.
facts.quote: if a campaign is running CTV only, it will reach 9% of a target audience.

facts.fact: StackAdapt platform data shows that adding video to a CTV campaign yields a total campaign reach of 77% of a target audience.
facts.quote: if video was added, the total campaign reach is 77%.
